jd_text: EMAIL_SCAN_JD_MARKER {{COMPANY}} is hiring a {{ROLE}} to own mobile and API automation architecture, Kotlin test frameworks, Appium device-lab reliability, contract testing, CI/CD paved roads, and observable test infrastructure.
